meaning:
1) to be sad, be disheartened
1a) (Niphal) to be disheartened, be cowed
1b) (Hiphil) to make sad

elsewhere.note: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.
Because with lies you have grieved the heart of the righteous, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return…
For ships of Kittim will come against him. Therefore he will be grieved, and will return, and have indignation against the holy covenant, and will take action.…
